newsitem.title: USA: Morgan Grenfell names Joan Binstock COO.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Grenfell names Joan Binstock COO.

text.p: Morgan Grenfell Capital Management said Wednesday that Joan Binstock will join the firm as executive vice president and chief operating officer, a newly created position.
Binstock, 43, was formerly a principal and national director of Investment Management Regulatory Consulting with Ernst & Young, LLP in New York.
As COO, Morgan Grenfell said, Binstock will focus on the non-portfolio management and non-marketing areas of the firm, including administration, compliance, finance and operations.
She will also contribute to the firm's strategic planning and overall corporate management, a statement issued by Morgan Grenfell said.
